description: Current SatoshiMacro Model (SMM) score for Bitcoin or Ethereum: a 0-100 market-cycle confluence score built from weighted percentile-ranked signals in six tiers (cycle timing, valuation, sentiment, rotation, miner, macro; Bitcoin uses 48 signals, Ethereum fewer). Returns the zone (Deep Value, Accumulation, Neutral, Caution, Distribution, Cycle Top), 7- and 30-day change, the six tier scores and 30 days of daily history. Use this when the user asks where Bitcoin or Ethereum sits in its market cycle, how the cycle score has moved recently, or which tier is driving it; use get_market_snapshot instead for a one-line overview of everything. Daily reading, refreshed twice a day (about 07:30 and 13:30 Sydney time); the date field is the last completed day. Descriptive data, not a price forecast or trading signal.
name: get_cycle_model_reading
title: SatoshiMacro Model reading
